prompt: Create a factual map of South America showing national borders and labeling every country. Also label the Andes Mountains, Amazon River, Amazon Basin, Atacama Desert, Brazilian Highlands, Pacific Ocean, and Atlantic Ocean. Include a scale bar, north arrow, and legend.

spec.title: Political and Physical Map of South America
spec.subtitle: Sovereign States, Major Geographic Features, and International Borders as of August 2026

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: South America physical features

notes: Amazon River geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m dataset.
Mountain, basin, desert and highland extents are generalized educational overviews, not legal or survey boundaries.
spec.referenceSummary: This map depicts the political boundaries of South America as of August 2026, including sovereign states, disputed territories, and major geographic features. Data sources include ISO country codes, U.S. State Department LSIB, and National Geographic.

checks.message: 14 mapped countries use Natural Earth 1:50m boundaries.
Every mapped region cites a declared web source.
10 web citations grounded the map specification.
Boundaries are schematic. Editorial review against the cited sources is required before publication.
French Guiana is classified in the data but not drawn separately by the Natural Earth 1:50m boundary dataset.
Known physical features were resolved from the local geographic catalogue instead of model-generated geometry.
